document.title: Authentication Flow
document.content:
# Authentication Flow

## Overview

This document describes the authentication flow for the Nyx platform.

## Steps

1. User navigates to the login page.
2. User enters credentials or selects an OAuth provider.
3. Clerk handles session creation and token issuance.
4. The frontend stores the session token and redirects to the dashboard.

## Token Refresh

Session tokens are short-lived (60 minutes). Clerk automatically refreshes tokens using a secure HTTP-only cookie.

## Logout

Calling `clerk.signOut()` invalidates the session on both client and server.
